words.sentence: He felt ashamed after he forgot his friend's birthday.

words.pattern: a_e spells long a in wake.

words.pattern: ea spells long e in neath.

words.sentence: Flowers brighten the whole room.

words.pattern: o_e spells long o in pose.

words.sentence: The pilot kept control of the plane in the wind.
words.pattern: The second o spells long o.
